title: fs-dir: slot management in wp11_pkcs11.c
description: Add slot_add_fs_dir() and slot_remove_fs_dir() in wp11_pkcs11.c. Scan the configured directory at C_Initialize: list files matching slot-N.p11k, parse N as the slot index, register each as a fs-dir slot. Honor WOLFP11_FS_DIR_PATH env var override of the compile-time default. Reuse flash slot struct fields (flash_path, keystore pointer).
